## Type of Change
- [ ] New training scenario

## Checklist
- [ ] No real IOCs, hostnames, usernames, or live incident data included
- [ ] Fictional data uses RFC 5737 IPs (198.51.100.x), [organisation] placeholders, defanged domains
- [ ] MITRE ATT&CK technique IDs referenced where applicable (T1566.001 format)
- [ ] Scenarios include: learning objectives, phases, debrief questions, trainer notes
- [ ] All placeholders in `[SQUARE_BRACKETS]` format
- [ ] Links to related documents in other repos use relative paths

## Review Requirements
- [ ] 1 approver — documentation fix or cert roadmap update
- [ ] Senior analyst or SOC Manager — new scenario or tabletop exercise
